bio.text: Jeremy Bynum, a Republican, has represented District 1 in the Alaska House of Representatives, based in Ketchikan, since 2025.

According to the legislative biography, Bynum has served on the Ketchikan Gateway Borough Assembly since 2020 and works as Electric Division Manager at Ketchikan Public Utilities, after earlier work as an engineer and manager with the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (2006-2016).
The biography lists a B.S. in electrical engineering from Portland State University (2005), U.S. Air Force service from 1995 to 2000 and Air National Guard service from 2001 to 2003.
